limitations: server metric counts successful body writes, not client-consumed bytes
loopback timings are not WAN performance
end-of-process file footprint is not peak temporary space or Windows VHDX allocation

host_version_capture.scope: Same host after primary measurement and reader replay; version verification, not a pre-run snapshot

host_machine_capture.memory_scope: Windows-reported physical RAM; not a WSL guest memory limit or sampled free memory.

http_field_scope: HTTP response metrics apply only to the loopback external-URL study; null means unmeasured for the real Hub study.
rss_field_scope: peak_rss_kib in rows/groups is ru_maxrss captured by an atexit callback after explicit cleanup, including imports. Separate 50 ms /proc VmHWM samples are retained in wrappers; this callback value is not a claim about the entire remaining interpreter shutdown.
